title: George Sr.'s day job, his temper and a fired bass player
summary: He worked days in cotton while playing nights; the interviewer relays Manetta's story of a fight with a bass player, whom George fired, and they recall his stern temper.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left
